title: Wire configured provider into M6 reasoning
goal: Ensure the canonical M6 Agent loop invokes the provider configured by M6CompositionRoot instead of silently falling back to DefaultReasoner.
context: M6CompositionRoot configures activeProvider and ProviderRuntime, but omits the reasoner argument when constructing M6Orchestrator. M6Orchestrator defaults to DefaultReasoner, which returns a synthetic string without calling the configured provider.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify UI, Package.swift, provider implementations, Skill permissions, or unrelated orchestration behavior.
Do not claim tests or CI passed without actual results.
acceptance_criteria: M6CompositionRoot injects LLMReasoner backed by the same activeProvider it configures.
A regression test proves the configured provider response becomes the M6 evaluation answer.
The change remains one logical commit and does not alter unrelated files.
verification: Review PR checks and changed-file scope
recovery: Revert the single task commit if the focused regression or full Swift package test suite fails.
